messages:
Logan: Hey all, Logan here (platform). First day -- trying to get a baseline dev env on my M2. Running into two things: 1) `asdf install golang 1.20.5` fails with a checksum/gpg error, 2) python via pyenv/asdf picks up system openssl and then pip fails to build cryptography wheels. Also the org dotfiles clone prompts for SSO and then 403s. Who's the right contact for SSO / org repo access and any quick fixes for the openssl/pip issue?

Maya: welcome! :wave: For the Go gpg problem, run `gpg --keyserver hkps://keys.openpgp.org --recv-keys 0xA7D2B12C` (plugin prints the key id on error). Then retry. For macOS cryptography wheel issues, brew install openssl@3 and set: `export LDFLAGS="-L$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/lib"` `export CPPFLAGS="-I$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/include"` and `export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/lib/pkgconfig"` before `pip install -r requirements.txt`. pyenv/asdf: `env PYTHON_CONFIGURE_OPTS="--with-openssl=$(brew --prefix openssl@3)" asdf install python 3.10.13` helped me.

Logan: Thanks — I didn't think to set PYTHON_CONFIGURE_OPTS. For the dotfiles SSO I get redirected to the SSO page but then it fails with "You don't have access". My manager told me infra team approves org access. Who to tag?

Evan: Hey Logan, I can add you to the org. Send me your GitHub username or accept the invite email; sometimes the invite goes to an alternate email. If SSO still blocks, DM me and I'll escalate. Also check 1Password onboarding entry for a pre-generated deploy key if you prefer that route.

DevX-Bot: Quick checklist: 1) Ensure `op signin redwood` is successful in the same shell session where you run the bootstrap. 2) For GPG: `gpg --list-keys` should show the key id the asdf plugin expects. 3) If pip wheel builds fail, try `pip install wheel setuptools-rust` first. 4) If you need the bootstrap script: `curl -fsSL https://redwood-internal.dev/onboarding/bootstrap.sh | bash` (requires SSO/VPN). Docs: https://redwood-internal.dev/setup/devbox.

Logan: One other oddity: when I tried to access https://redwood-internal.dev I got a 401 unless I'm on VPN. Is VPN automatic for new hires or infra has to enable it? Manager said infra must enable access.

infra-bot: To request VPN and SSO org access, open a ticket in #help with subject "New hire access: VPN + GitHub org". Include: full name, GitHub username, laptop serial (or type), office location (or remote), and your manager. Typical turnaround 2 business hours. For urgent cases ask manager to escalate.

Maya: FYI if you run into long compile times for Go or Python builds on M2, try `arch -arm64` prefixes for brew and asdf installs to avoid Rosetta, e.g., `arch -arm64 brew install ...` and `arch -arm64 asdf install ...`. Also if you prefer fish/zsh we have templates in infra/dotfiles-personal-template.

Logan: Great, thanks everyone. I'll open the help ticket and try the env flags + gpg key. Will report back here if anything else pops up.
